title: TIMELINE
lede: Every dated event in the archive, laid end to end. Late 2023 to October 2026: from three medalists and a demo video to a $40-billion conversation.
body:
## 2023 — THE QUIET YEAR
whenevent
late 2023Scott Wu, Steven Hao, and Walden Yan — all IOI gold medalists — found Cognition in San Francisco
## 2024 — THE DEMO YEAR
whenevent
early 2024Founders Fund wires $21M at a $350M valuation
mar 12Devin unveiled — ‘the first AI software engineer’; 13.86% SWE-bench claim; interviews passed, Upwork jobs done
aprFounders Fund leads $175M at $2B — unicorn in the first public quarter
mar–decearly-access program runs; Devin mutates behind the curtain
dec 10Devin GA — $500/mo, unlimited seats, Slack + IDE extension + API
## 2025 — THE ACQUISITION YEAR
whenevent
mar8VC-led round marks ~$4B valuation
springDevin pricing drops to a $20 Core tier — ACUs replace seats
apr 25DeepWiki opens — free AI wiki for every public GitHub repo
may 15SWE-1 family ships in Windsurf Wave 9 — SWE-1, -lite, -mini
may 22DeepWiki MCP server ships
mid-yearKevin-32B — multi-turn RL CUDA kernel model, open weights
junDevin ARR reaches $73M (from $1M the previous September)
jul 11Google’s $2.4B reverse-acquihire guts Windsurf’s leadership
jul 14Cognition acquires Windsurf — signed over a single weekend
sep$400M+ raise at $10.2B post-money; lifetime net burn still under $20M
oct 16SWE-grep — the context-retrieval specialist
oct 29SWE-1.5 — 950 tok/s via Cerebras; the ‘Falcon Alpha’ mystery resolved
## 2026 — THE FLAGSHIP YEAR
whenevent
early 2026SWE-1.6 Preview published mid-run — +11% SWE-Bench Pro over 1.5
aprSWE-1.6 GA — ‘model UX’, free for three months
mayreported valuation reaches ~$26B
junWindsurf renamed Devin Desktop — one brand, two tempos
jul 8SWE-1.7 — RL inside the Devin harness, Cerebras at 1000 TPS
augBloomberg: fundraising talks at ≥$40B
sep 10SWE-2 — Kimi K3 base, multi-trillion RL, effort levels, FrontierCode 50.0%
octthe annals you are reading are compiled by a dog and committed to the archive
## THE SHAPE OF IT 
2023   ▇ founders
mar'24   ▇▇ devin demo
dec'24   ▇▇▇ GA — $500/mo
apr'25   ▇▇▇▇ deepwiki · core tier
may'25   ▇▇▇▇▇ swe-1 family
jul'25   ▇▇▇▇▇▇ windsurf acquired
sep'25   ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ $10.2B raise
oct'25   ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ swe-1.5 + swe-grep
apr'26   ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ swe-1.6
jul'26   ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ swe-1.7
sep'26   ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ SWE-2

Dates as publicly reported; mid-year items placed where the record is fuzzy. When two sources disagreed, the louder one lost.
